rows.grounds: locative indicating the context of ritual worship
optative expressing prohibition in context with negation
indefinite temporal adverb reinforcing total prohibition

items.question: May the previously described items ever be employed in ritual worship?
premises: Earlier verses described items associated with liberation and enjoyment.
The verse issues a prohibition regarding their use in worship.
The prohibition is reinforced as applying at all times.
items.inference: Therefore, the previously described items must never be employed in worship.
items.plain_english: O fair-hipped one, they should never be used in worship.
